howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The image is decoded with libtiff and written as a lossless PNG with full color depth preserved.

faq.a: TIFF is excellent for archival but heavyweight and not browser-friendly. PNG is universally supported and still lossless — perfect for sharing scanned documents online.
Yes. Both TIFF and PNG are lossless image formats, so no pixel data is lost. The PNG is typically 30–60% smaller because PNG's compression is more efficient for typical scan content.
Only the first page is converted. For multi-page TIFF archives, use our TIFF to PDF tool to preserve every page.
